description: Kris Kobach today announced that 33 Kansas sheriffs endorse his campaign for Kansas Attorney General. Alongside Shawnee County Sheriff Brian Hill, Kobach laid out his plans to maintain and improve law and order in the state of Kansas.

title: Kobach Launches Law & Order Plan with Endorsement of 35 Kansas Sheriffs | Kris Kobach for Attorney General
